name: Twigs
text: A bundle of thin dry twigs, gathered for the alchemist's mortar.

name: Green Leaves
text: Fresh green leaves that still smell of the forest.

name: Red Flowers
text: Bright red blossoms picked by the roadside.

name: Yellow Flowers
text: Yellow blossoms with a sharp, sweet scent.

name: Root Tendrils
text: Thin pale roots pulled from damp earth.

name: Root Bulb
text: A swollen root bulb, starchy and bitter.

name: Pine Branch
text: A resinous pine branch, sticky with sap.

name: Green Berries
text: Hard unripe berries, sour enough to make the eyes water.

name: Red Berries
text: Ripe red berries that stain the fingers.

name: Yellow Berries
text: Small yellow berries with a bitter skin.

name: Clover
text: A sprig of clover, common as grass and twice as lucky.

name: Red Rose
text: A red rose, its thorns still sharp.

name: Yellow Rose
text: A yellow rose, pale as winter sunlight.

name: Black Rose
text: A rare black rose, said to grow best on graves.

name: White Rose
text: A white rose, the sign of purity in Breton songs.

name: Red Poppy
text: A red poppy with petals as thin as paper.

name: Black Poppy
text: A black poppy whose seeds bring heavy dreams.

name: Golden Poppy
text: A golden poppy that closes its petals at dusk.

name: White Poppy
text: A white poppy, pale and drowsy.

name: Ginkgo Leaves
text: Fan-shaped ginkgo leaves, said to sharpen the memory.

name: Bamboo
text: A hollow length of bamboo from the southern jungles.

name: Palm
text: A palm frond from the warm coasts.

name: Aloe
text: A fleshy aloe leaf full of cooling sap.

name: Fig
text: A soft purple fig, sweet and full of seeds.

name: Cactus
text: A spiny desert cactus full of bitter water.

name: Werewolf's Blood
text: Dark blood drawn from a werewolf, still smelling of the hunt.

name: Wereboar's Tusk
text: A curved tusk torn from a wereboar.

name: Fairy Dragon's Scales
text: Iridescent scales shed by a tiny fairy dragon.

name: Nymph Hair
text: A lock of nymph hair that shimmers like running water.

name: Unicorn Horn
text: A spiral horn of pearly white, the rarest of trophies.

name: Wraith Essence
text: A cold grey vapour bottled from a slain wraith.

name: Ectoplasm
text: A pale slime left behind by restless spirits.

name: Ghoul's Tongue
text: The black tongue of a ghoul, foul even when dried.

name: Spider's Venom
text: A vial of venom milked from a giant spider.

name: Troll's Blood
text: Thick green troll blood that seems to knit itself back together.

name: Snake Venom
text: A few drops of snake venom in a corked vial.

name: Gorgon Snake
text: A small snake from a gorgon's crown, dead but still unsettling.

name: Lich Dust
text: Grey dust that once was a lich, still faintly cold.

name: Dragon's Scales
text: Dragon scales the size of plates, harder than steel.

name: Giant Scorpion Stinger
text: The curved stinger of a giant scorpion, its venom sac still full.

name: Small Scorpion Stinger
text: A small scorpion's stinger, sharp as a needle.

name: Mummy Wrappings
text: Brittle linen wrappings that smell of ancient spices.

name: Giant's Blood
text: Giant's blood, thick and warm even in a cold vial.

name: Basilisk's Eye
text: A basilisk's eye, its gaze dulled but not quite gone.

name: Gryphon's Feather
text: A great flight feather from a gryphon's wing.

name: Daedra's Heart
text: The heart of a slain daedra, still faintly warm.

name: Saint's Hair
text: A lock of hair said to come from a saint.

name: Holy Relic
text: A fragment of something holy, wrapped with reverence.

name: Big Tooth
text: A great tooth pulled from some large beast.

name: Medium Tooth
text: A tooth from a beast of middling size.

name: Small Tooth
text: A small sharp tooth from a little beast.

name: Pure Water
text: Water drawn from a clean spring and kept sealed.

name: Rain Water
text: Rain water caught before it touched the ground.

name: Orc's Blood
text: Dark orcish blood, thick and strong-smelling.

name: Elixir Vitae
text: A golden distillate that alchemists call the water of life.

name: Nectar
text: Sweet nectar gathered from countless flowers.

name: Ichor
text: A golden fluid said to run in the veins of the divine.

name: Mercury
text: Quicksilver that runs like water and never wets the hand.

name: Tin
text: A lump of soft grey tin.

name: Brass
text: A lump of yellow brass that shines when polished.

name: Lodestone
text: A dark stone that pulls iron toward it.

name: Sulphur
text: Yellow sulphur that reeks of the volcano.

name: Lead
text: A heavy, dull lump of lead.

name: Iron
text: A lump of raw iron ore, red with rust.

name: Copper
text: Copper ore streaked with green.

name: Silver
text: Silver ore that gleams where it is broken.

name: Gold
text: Gold ore with bright flecks in the stone.

name: Platinum
text: A rare lump of platinum ore, heavier than it looks.

name: Ivory
text: A piece of polished ivory, smooth and creamy white.

name: Pearl
text: A lustrous pearl from the depths of the sea.

name: Indulcet
text: A sweet-smelling narcotic resin, banned in most of the Empire.

name: Sursum
text: A stimulant powder that lifts the spirits and empties the purse.

name: Quaesto Vil
text: A dark powder that sharpens the senses until they hurt.

name: Aegrotat
text: A sickly-sweet drug that dulls pain and will alike.
